scope: Original discrete focused logical keyboard path in the existing Field consumer, through unchanged native buttons/commands and actual paid C#consequences.
baseline: Exact old app.js produces0shortcut POSTs against separately fingerprinted current focus wrapper; native Tab/Enter buttons already worked before. This is not a claim of previously absent keyboard access.
result: Actual keyboard and matched pointer full owner states equal. Same-person two-encounter keyboard route completes XP25/HP11/resolve3/two rigs/two attempts. Empty slots remain actual owner refusals.
policy: Unmodified logical ArrowRight/wait-period/1-4 only while road surface focused. Existing enabled button.click delegates once; no queue, timer, gameplay grants or new owner. All tracked mapped keys must release after interruptions before fresh intent. Entry/sample/withdraw remain explicit buttons.

source_boundary: No C#source changed anywhere, no whole-C#-tree assay drift, no new source-consumption decision, no new app/save/package. All protected Brain/reference/source variants and both recipient ZIPs remain unchanged.

research_and_review.engineering: ENG009/015; reuse same buttons and reject temporal intent after interruption.

research_and_review.disagreement: Engineering W/E versus Creative ArrowRight/period resolved in favor of logical arrow/wait punctuation to avoid implying continuous WASD movement. Production ownership and portfolio remain strategic alternatives.

Failure and hash-verified producer/app preimages retained; not accepted as final execution. Older successful36-control run has historical Host identity; final run reexecutes actual rebuilt Host.

limitations: Synthetic Chromium/C#command execution only; no physical device latency, reaction-time, human usability/accessibility/preference, Unity Editor/Windows Player/Steam or production multiplayer claim.
Logical unmodified mappings are not remappable; layouts requiring Shift for digits/period are not validated. Native pointer and Tab/Enter controls remain.
Consumer is trusted-local and ephemeral; public debug API and shared filesystem are not sandbox/security isolation.
allocation: ONE North Star product unit. UI/instrument/CI/navigation/regression support are not extra units. No fixed task rotation; compare production/portfolio ownership next.
